Pazapa English for Adults

Week 1, Lesson 2 — Step 3: Pronunciation Clinic

Screen 1 of 8

Pronunciation Clinic

Listen and practise clear English.

Écoutez et prononcez l’anglais clairement.

Today: your age and your languages.

You can listen many times. Speaking aloud is your choice. Nothing is saved or sent.

Vous pouvez écouter autant de fois que vous voulez. Parler à voix haute est facultatif. Rien n’est enregistré ni envoyé.

Say an age

Listen. Then say it.

Écoutez. Puis dites-le.

Say the strong words a little longer and a little louder.

I am 35 years old.

Two short parts

I am

35 years old

I am 18 years old.

Say it aloud if you like. No microphone here. Use a fictional age.

Dites-le à voix haute si vous voulez. Pas de micro ici. Utilisez un âge fictif.

Say a language

Listen. Then say it.

Écoutez. Puis dites-le.

I speak Arabic.

More models

I speak French.

I speak English.

That’s useful English. Use the model if you need help.

Utilisez le modèle si vous avez besoin d’aide.

Say a little English

Listen to the whole sentence. Then listen to the two parts.

Écoutez la phrase entière. Puis écoutez les deux parties.

I speak French and a little English.

Two natural parts

I speak French

and a little English

Slow speech is still natural speech. Keep the two parts smooth.

Parlez lentement, mais de façon naturelle. Gardez les deux parties fluides.

Question voice

Listen to the end of the question.

Écoutez la fin de la question.

How old are you?voice rises

The voice goes up at the end. Say it aloud if you like.

La voix monte à la fin. Dites-le à voix haute si vous voulez.

Smooth sentence

Listen. Then say the sentence in one smooth line.

Écoutez. Puis dites la phrase d’un seul trait.

I am learning English.

Two fictional profiles

  • Amina

    I am 35 years old. I speak French and a little English.

  • Samira

    I am 18 years old. I speak Arabic. I am learning English.

These profiles are fictional. Practise with them. Do not use your own details.

Ces profils sont fictifs. Entraînez-vous avec eux. N’utilisez pas vos informations personnelles.

Record yourself — if you want to

This is optional. You can skip it.

C’est facultatif. Vous pouvez passer cette étape.

Listen to the model first.

I’m 30 years old. I speak Arabic and a little English.

Your private recording

The audio stays on this device. It is never uploaded, saved or scored.

L’audio reste sur cet appareil. Il n’est ni envoyé, ni conservé, ni noté.

You’re building confidence. Listening again is a good choice too.

Vous progressez. Réécouter est aussi un bon choix.

Pronunciation Clinic complete

You practised clear age and language sentences.

Vous avez pratiqué des phrases claires sur l’âge et les langues.

  • I can say an age.
  • I can say a language.
  • I can say and a little English.
  • I can hear the question voice in How old are you?

Pazapa English for Adults — Week 1, Lesson 2, Step 3. All names, ages and languages shown are fictional.
